title: This Octopus Can Pretend to Be Three Different Venomous Animals

scenes.text: One octopus can pretend to be three different venomous animals.
It lives in muddy waters off Indonesia, and it's called the mimic octopus.
Spread its striped arms, and it looks like a lionfish.
Hide six arms in a hole and wave two, and it looks like a sea snake.
Flatten out and glide, and it looks like a poisonous flatfish.

description:
The mimic octopus can imitate venomous sea snakes, lionfish and flatfish to scare off predators.
Scientists think it chooses its disguise based on which predator is nearby.
Which costume would you wear?
first_comment: Bonus: divers have also seen it act like a jellyfish and a crab. Which disguise is your favorite?
